title.narrative: Bank of Xingtai Green Finance Development Project

description.narrative: Asian Development Bank (ADB) proposes a financial intermediation loan in an amount of $200 million to Bank of Xingtai, a regional city commercial bank in Hebei Province, to provide critically needed long-term debt at competitive rate to promote green finance in Hebei Province. The ADB funds will compensate for the negative externalities and incentivize green finance lending by adopting an international green finance definition and help improve green finance's regulatory effectiveness in the People's Republic of China (PRC). Bank of Xingtai will allocate up to $1 million equivalent to strengthen its institutional capacity to green finance and its related lending experiences. The overall assistance package (lending and capacity development) should greatly facilitate the improvement of Hebei Province's environmental condition, which is a regional public goods to the Beijing, Tianjin, and Hebei Province region.

Output: Bank of Xingtai's ESG and related institutional capacities improved Indicator: At least 30 credit and treasury staff receive at least three trainings on financial and risk management assessment, including financial and treasury functions, and reported improved knowledge by 2026 Achievement: 300 Progress/Status: In order to improve the IA's capacity, BOX was invited to participate the webinars and forums on international best practices of PRI, ESG, GRI and green development. BOX team regularly participate ADB's trainings on safeguards, gender, financial management, project management, disbursement, and green financing. A gender unit for developing gender-sensitive lending products established, operational, and working with borrowers by 2022.
BOX has developed the “Xiangniu Liren” loan product for female customers. This product is a revolving loan for personal business of female natural persons who are engaged in production and operation in the districts where BOX operates, have good operating conditions, abide by laws and regulations, are honest and trustworthy, and have no records of poor credit. The loan interest rate is lower than that of loans granted to other small and micro enterprises. The guarantee, repayment and loan term can be tailored to customers' needs. A gender-sensitive human resources and operational guideline has been approved by Bank of Xingtai.
The "BOX Staff Recruitment Management Measures" issued in September 2022 clearly puts forward the principles of "staff recruitment shall follow the principles of merit, openness and fairness, equality between men and women, merit-based recruitment, scientific allocation, appointment on merits, application of talent, compliance with the law, and recusal of relatives". At the same time, in order to protect the legitimate rights and interests of female employees, female recruitment officers are required to participate in the entire recruitment process.
